name: Sand-Swimming
body:
Sand-Swimming Creature (CR +0)

This simple template can only be applied to creatures with the aquatic subtype. Sand-swimming creatures swim through sand instead of water.

A sand-swimming creature’s quick and rebuild rules are the same.

Rebuild Rules: Type lose the aquatic subtype, gain the earth subtype; Speed replace swim speed with an equivalent burrow speed, gain earth glide; Environment any desert.
